tools.name: xero_prepare_accounting_case
tools.title: Prepare a governed Xero Accounting Case
tools.description: Accepts ordinary source-document fields and compiles them into one tenant-bound, versioned Accounting Case. The server deterministically derives internal fact, lineage, event, source-unit and line IDs. Supply source-declared amounts only; Xero IDs, account codes, tax types, routes, computed ledger payloads and target identity remain server-side. First creation uses expected_version 0. This step performs no Xero write and always reports ledger_write as NOT_WRITTEN. Submitted/model-extracted facts remain source_truth_claim=NOT_VERIFIED and original_file_verified=false.

case_id.description: Agent-chosen stable Case identity; it is not a provider or tenant ID.

expected_version.description: Use 0 when creating the first Case version.

continuation_token.description: Opaque server-issued continuation token. Never construct or modify it.

source_set_complete.description: True only when this submitted Case's bounded source set is complete. It never asserts the whole business, ledger, period, or real-world document population is complete.

document_type.description: Business document direction and kind; this is not a provider action or route ID.

reference_kind.description: Meaning of the source reference. FORMAL_DOCUMENT_NUMBER is an issuer-assigned number for one document; GENERIC_RECURRING_REFERENCE is a reusable label that may recur on different dates. This is source evidence, not a provider ID, and must never be inferred from the string format.

name.description: Counterparty name exactly as shown by the source document. Existing contacts are resolved server-side by this identity.

email.description: Source-supported contact email; omit when the source does not contain it.

durable_identity.description: Typed durable identity. Omit unless the source supports every namespace field; a bare number must never be upgraded by inference.

jurisdiction.description: Registration jurisdiction supported by the source, for example SG or US.

registry_scheme.description: Issuing registry or scheme, for example ACRA_UEN or IRS_EIN.

namespace.description: Explicit account-number namespace whose uniqueness is guaranteed inside this Xero tenant.

company_number.description: Legacy bare provider field. It is collision/read-back evidence only; use durable_identity for a namespaced legal identity.

account_number.description: Legacy bare provider field. It is collision/read-back evidence only and is not a provider contact ID.

invoice_exchange_rate.description: Optional source-supported invoice exchange rate. Omit rather than guess; the server will block a foreign-currency route when required evidence is absent.

transition_review_required.description: Required source-review conclusion. Use true when GST transition facts are present or unresolved; use false only when the transaction has been reviewed as non-transitional. Never decide this from invoice date alone.

original_document.description: Provider-neutral historical linkage. The server resolves the exact original from complete provider history; this coordinate carries no provider ID.

reference.description: Ordinary issuer reference of the historical original invoice or bill. Never supply a provider object ID.

reference_kind.description: Source-supported meaning of the historical original reference.

document_date.description: Date of the historical original invoice or bill.

accounting_category.description: Explicit document line default. Used only in DOCUMENT_DEFAULT_FOR_ALL_LINES mode: CONSULTING_REVENUE, OFFICE_SUPPLIES, CLOUD_SUBSCRIPTIONS.

tax_class.description: Explicit document line default. Used only in DOCUMENT_DEFAULT_FOR_ALL_LINES mode: SG_STANDARD_RATED, NO_TAX, ZERO_RATED, OUT_OF_SCOPE, EXEMPT.

effective_tax_rate_percent.description: Explicit document line default effective tax percentage. Used only in DOCUMENT_DEFAULT_FOR_ALL_LINES mode.

quantity.description: Positive decimal string, for example 1 or 2.5000.

unit_amount_excluding_tax.description: Per-unit amount before tax, as a decimal string.

source_tax_amount.description: Tax printed for this source line, as a decimal string.

tools.name: xero_execute_accounting_case
tools.title: Execute eligible Xero Accounting Case drafts
tools.description: Executes only the immutable eligible operations stored in the exact current Accounting Case version under standing delegation. It accepts no payload, tenant, action, account, tax, receipt or confirmation phrase, stops on uncertain writes, and reports ledger success only with provider receipt plus exact readback for each eligible write. Ledger readback never verifies the submitted source or original file; source_truth_claim remains NOT_VERIFIED.

tools.title: Get governed Xero Accounting Case status
tools.description: Returns bounded case coverage, residual exceptions, source-truth status and per-operation receipt/readback status. It distinguishes unverified submitted-source truth, supplied-set coverage and verified ledger writes, and never claims original-file or whole-business completeness.

tools.name: xero_connection_status
tools.title: Xero connection status
tools.description: Returns connector control-plane health and the current compatibility selection. It does not prove a ledger target; first call xero_pin_current_organisation, then verify with xero_get_organisation using that target_session_ref. Organisation changes require a separate short-lived user confirmation page and never happen silently from chat text.

tools.name: xero_start_organisation_switch
tools.title: Switch Xero organisation
tools.description: Creates a short-lived one-time link where the user can explicitly choose another Xero organisation already covered by the current Xero authorization. This tool only starts the confirmation flow; it does not switch from chat text alone. After the page completes, call xero_pin_current_organisation before continuing ledger work.

tools.name: xero_pin_current_organisation
tools.title: Pin current Xero organisation
tools.description: Call this before ledger work and again after an organisation switch or target expiry. It pins the current Xero organisation into a short-lived opaque target_session_ref scoped to the verified OAuth installation principal and immutable ledger binding; pass that capability to every subsequent ledger tool. The server does not trust client-supplied conversation headers as identity.
